key_values.computed_consequence: The NYC signal passes all three gates, so the data support a concentrated rainfall and street/sewer disruption ledger rather than surge, wind, or remote-damage dominance.

primary_gt.computed_consequence: The NYC signal passes all three gates, so the data support a concentrated rainfall and street/sewer disruption ledger rather than surge, wind, or remote-damage dominance.

criteria.description: Returns the requested object with target_family, metrics, gates, score, max_score, answer, and computed_consequence.
criteria.name: Compact JSON target
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the structure is mostly complete but one required group is missing or field names are unclear.

criteria.description: Reports 133.9 mm event total, 33.8 mm peak hour, 98.3 mm wettest 6-hour total, and 0.7341 wettest 6-hour share.
criteria.name: Rainfall load and concentration
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for minor rounding errors or one missing rainfall value; 1 point for only the total or peak hour.

criteria.description: Reports 500 records, 0.914 sewer share, and 0.892 street-flooding share.
criteria.name: Service-record shares
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct count with one share wrong or rounded too coarsely; 1 point for recognizing the street/sewer signal without computing shares.

criteria.description: Applies the three stated gates and returns all three as true with score 3 of 3.
criteria.name: Gate logic and score
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct gate arithmetic with one threshold mistake; 1 point for using the right idea but not the stated thresholds.

criteria.name: Final label
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for a broadly rainfall-driven urban flood label that omits the service-record signal.

criteria.description: Explains that surge, wind, and remote-damage dominance are weaker because the ledger passes rainfall, street/sewer, and exposure gates.
criteria.name: Alternative dominance rejection
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if only one or two competing pathways are addressed.

criteria.description: Provides a concise ledger-tied consequence with no direct loss estimate from the population proxy.
criteria.name: Concision and inference control
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if the response is mostly concise but adds minor extra interpretation beyond the computed values.
